people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder at the age of her defining deed, 380: on the cone above the rain forest, a slight woman under a spotted-bamboo umbrella, having stopped mid-sentence because rain has begun. She listens to rain fall on the whole forest at once.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder at forty-five, faded and yellowed like an old silk painting with darkened edges, a slight woman standing under a spotted-bamboo umbrella who has stopped speaking mid-sentence because the first rain has begun. Face: most important, the large umbrella of split bamboo, its ribs covered with oiled paper and the poles spotted brown-purple, fills the top of the frame, and under it her small, fine-boned, serene face is turned up and listening; pale brown skin, ageless, closed or half-closed pale eyes, thin lifted brows, a small straight nose, lips parted as if the next word is lost. Hair: black with silver threads, in a low knot at the nape held by a slim bronze pin and a dark silver hairpin. Body: slight, narrow and still. Clothing: three layers of storm-violet and black silk with crossed collars, a long black oiled-silk over-robe falling around her like rain, wide sleeves whose cuffs are embroidered with silver raindrops and forked lightning, a narrow black sash hung with a small bronze bell and a violet jade pendant. Hands and objects: both slender hands hold the umbrella's handle; a small bronze rain-cup shaped like a bell without a clapper hangs from a rib on a cord. Power: very faint threads of violet-white lightning crawl along the umbrella's ribs and silver motes of rain hang suspended in the air around her, the mark of a great founder. Background: a pale grey wash with faint slanted lines of rain, the ghostly shape of a tall tower and a forest in mist. Light: faint, pale spirit-light as from old silk, a soft rim of silver along her shoulders. Expression: still, listening, lost in sound.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the drummer's boy at sixteen, the day he climbed the cone with the storm notes in his head. One ear is turned toward the sky, his palms callused by the drumsticks.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the drummer's boy at sixteen, faded like an old silk painting, on the day he climbed the cone with the storm notes ringing in his head. Face: most important, his head is tilted hard to the right and the left ear lifted toward the sky, the eyes unfocused; a thin, earnest, dark-skinned boy's face with high cheekbones, large dark distant eyes, thin straight brows, a straight nose, a firm young mouth slightly open. Hair: black, damp with rain, gathered in a topknot with a strip of pale drum-skin and a small dark silver pin. Body: thin, tall for his age, a little bent. Clothing: a young disciple's graceful robe of storm-grey silk with two crossed collars of black and violet, wide sleeves a little short at the wrist, a black gauze over-robe that falls like rain, cuffs embroidered with thin silver lightning, a black sash with a tiny bronze bell. Hands and objects: both open hands held at his chest with palms toward the viewer, thick yellow callus pads across each palm, drumstick marks plain to see; two wooden drumsticks held between the left fingers. Power: faint violet sparks flicker between his drumsticks and a few motes of white lightning drift near his lifted ear, strong for a boy who will be an elder. Background: a pale grey wash with the faint shape of a mountain slope, clouds and a forked white lightning far behind. Light: faint pale spirit-light as from old silk, a thin violet rim at the cheek. Expression: intent, distant and unafraid.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the founder's war captain in 618, bareheaded in the rain in the burning orchards of Hồng Vũ Thành, refusing to leave. His red beard is wet. The red rain that fell was said to be his.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the founder's war captain at fifty, faded like old silk, bareheaded in the rain among the burning orchards of Hồng Vũ Thành, refusing to leave; the red rain that fell was said to be his. Face: most important, a thick, wet, rust-red beard trimmed square, vivid against the faded silk, and a bareheaded brow streaming with rain; a broad, hard, weathered face with deep-set pale blue-grey eyes, heavy red-brown brows, a big straight nose with a scar across the bridge and a wide stubborn mouth. Hair: red-brown, wet, cropped short and plastered to the skull. Body: big, deep-chested, square shoulders planted wide. Clothing: the rich robes of an elder of a dark Thunder house, layered black and storm-violet brocade with crossed collars, an over-robe of black oiled silk thrown back from his shoulders and scuffed along the hem by campaigns, a high collar embroidered in silver lightning, a broad sash fastened by a dark silver clasp and hung with a bronze bell, no hat. Hands and objects: his right hand grips the hilt of a long plain sword planted point-down in the earth before him, the left resting over it. Power: a heavy aura of red-orange heat and violet lightning rolls off his shoulders, the sword's edge glimmering, the strength of a Kết Đan elder. Background: pale grey rain, drifting pink and red petals, a faint orange glow of burning trees far behind. Light: faint spirit-light as from old silk with a red-orange tint at the edges, as from distant fire. Expression: stubborn and fearless, immovable, the look of a captain who has decided this ground is the last he will give up.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the guest elder at the Night Rain Edict in 905, arriving by night with his scripture as his price. A grey, dry man; his hand, offered in greeting, leaves the hand it touches cold.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the guest elder at sixty-two, faded like an old silk painting, arriving by night at the Night Rain Edict with his scripture as his price, one hand held out in greeting. Face: most important, his skin is ash-grey and dry as paper with no flush at all, and his extended long bony hand is just as grey; a narrow, gaunt face with heavy-lidded, patient, dark eyes whose whites are yellowish, thin grey brows, a sharp thin nose, a thin pale mouth with a patient, empty smile and a wisp of grey beard. Hair: white-grey, thin, tied tight in a knot with a black wood pin and a slim silver crown-clasp. Body: tall, thin, upright and dry. Clothing: a guest elder's rich robes of ash-grey and black silk in three crossed layers, a long black oiled-silk over-robe, new and finely cut, with silver lightning embroidered at the collar, cuffs very clean, a black sash with a jade pendant, a straw rain hat hanging at his back by a cord. Hands and objects: the right hand held out in greeting, long fingers; the left holds a slim scroll tied with a black cord against his chest. Power: a cold pale mist clings to his outstretched hand and the air near it seems to chill, thin frost-grey wisps of qi curling around his sleeve, an elder's quiet strength. Background: a wash of pale grey with the faint shape of a doorway and slanting rain. Light: cold faint spirit-light as from old silk, a pale rim along the grey hand. Expression: patient, thin-smiling, cold and unreadable.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the lightning-rod man on the wall of Thủ Lôi Bảo in 1042, bareheaded in a storm, holding on the ninth day. His Thunder lets him stand under a strike. He burns with the wall.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the lightning-rod man at forty, faded like old silk, on the wall of Thủ Lôi Bảo in the storm of the ninth day, bareheaded, holding. His Thunder lets him stand under a strike; he burns with the wall. Face: most important, a huge, square man's face turned straight up into the storm, hair standing on end and a faint scorch on the cheeks; broad, rough and brown with a heavy jaw, small bright eyes half shut against the rain, thick black brows, a flat wide nose and a mouth set in a stubborn line. Hair: black, wet, standing up in thick spikes, no cap. Body: enormous, broad as a door, planted. Clothing: an elder's heavy layered robes of black and storm-violet silk, the over-robe scorched along the hem and left unmended on purpose, open at the chest over a grey inner robe with a crossed collar, wide sleeves, silver lightning embroidered across the shoulders, a broad sash with a bronze buckle. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round a long black iron rod taller than he is, the top lost in the sky. Power: white-violet lightning runs down the iron rod and over his arms and shoulders without harming him, motes of fire lifting from his scorched hem, the force of a Kết Đan elder. Background: a pale wash of grey with a forked white line of lightning and the faint line of a wall. Light: faint pale spirit-light as from old silk, a thin white flash at the edge. Expression: steadfast, loyal and slow.

people.imagined: A memorial portrait of the head's Dao partner at Đan Sơn Mạch, holding the rear guard. She laughs loudly, hair cropped short for the sword, the pass at her back. She has sent four people out with the wounded.
people.subject: The moment: a memorial portrait of the head's Dao partner at thirty-eight, faded like old silk, holding the rear guard at the pass of Đan Sơn Mạch; she laughs loudly, the pass at her back, having sent four people out with the wounded. Face: most important, her black hair is cropped very short above the ears, almost like a man's, and she laughs with her whole open mouth; a tall ferryman's daughter's strong, wide, weathered face with bright dark eyes creased with laughter, strong straight brows, a wide nose and a big mouth showing strong white teeth. Hair: black, cut short and uneven for the sword, with one small silver clasp at the temple. Body: tall and strong-shouldered, long-armed, in a swordswoman's easy planted stance. Clothing: an elder's flowing robes of black and storm-violet silk in layered crossed collars, wide sleeves tied back for the fight, a long black gauze over-robe thrown back from her shoulders with mud on its hem from the pass, silver lightning at the cuffs, a black sash hung with a jade pendant and a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: a plain unsheathed sword rests flat on her right shoulder, held by the hilt; her left hand sits on her hip. Power: violet lightning crawls along the bare blade and a bright halo of white-gold sparks rises round her, the strength of a Kết Đan elder in her last stand. Background: a pale grey wash, the faint walls of a narrow pass, slanting rain. Light: faint spirit-light as from old silk, a silver rim on her laughing face. Expression: a big laugh, brave and loving, with a flash of wrath in the eyes at whatever lies beyond the pass.

people.imagined: The ridge before a storm. Her hair is standing up a little in the charged air and she grins at the sky. Gold dust glints in the creases of her knuckles. She wants to choose her own master.
people.subject: The moment: the ridge before a storm, a young woman of twenty-seven grinning at the sky, her hair standing up in the charged air; she wants to choose her own master. Face: most important, her black hair stands up in wisps and floating strands all round her head and her knuckles glint with fine gold dust; a wiry young woman's narrow, bright, tanned face, large quick dark eyes shining with delight, thin upswept dark brows, a short nose, a wide quick mouth in a daring grin with one chipped tooth. Hair: black, in a high tail whose strands rise and float, a small dark silver clasp holding it. Body: wiry, springy, in a duellist's stance. Clothing: the graceful silk of an inner disciple of a Thunder house, a robe of black and storm-violet with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, a black gauze over-robe thrown back and scorched a little at the hem, silver lightning embroidered along the cuffs, a black sash with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: her right hand grips the hilt of a plain sword with a faint gold-flecked blade at her hip; the knuckles of the hand lifted in the frame glitter with gold dust. Power: a crackle of white-violet lightning plays in her hair and along her fingers, with glints of gold-white metal motes beside it. Background: a dark purple-grey storm sky with a thin white fork of lightning and a mountain slope in mist. Light: cold bright spirit-light from the upper left, a faint blue crackle at her hair. Expression: bold, restless, eager.

people.imagined: The night of spring rain. He sits with a three-stringed qin on his knees and turns his whole body toward a speaker, the way the blind do. He wants to hear the founder's chain ring. He will not be anyone's weapon.
people.subject: The moment: the night of spring rain in a dark hall, a young blind man of twenty-nine sitting with a three-stringed qin on his knees and turning his whole body toward a speaker; he wants to hear the founder's chain ring and will not be anyone's weapon. Face: most important, his eyes are milky white, wide open and unfocused, with no visible iris, pointed just past the viewer; a thin, pale, finely made face with a high forehead, delicate lifted brows, a straight narrow nose, a soft patient mouth and a faint smile of attention. Hair: black and long, tied in a loose tail at the nape with a grey cord and a small silver hairpin, a few damp strands clinging to the brow. Body: thin and slight, narrow-shouldered, the torso turned square to the voice. Clothing: a true-disciple's robe of black and storm-violet silk in three crossed layers, a long black gauze over-robe with silver raindrops embroidered down the sleeves, a neat collar, a sash of storm-grey silk hung with a small bronze bell. Hands and objects: a qin of dark wood lies across his knees with only four of its seven strings left, his right hand resting on the strings; along the qin's side lies the sword Apricot Rain in a black scabbard, its grip carved all over in apricot blossom for his thumb to read. Power: faint rings of pale water-blue and silver light ripple out from the strings like drops on a pond. Background: a dark hall at night, rain on a lattice window, the soft glow of a lantern. Light: soft lantern light from the upper left, rain-blue spirit-light behind him. Expression: attentive and calm, a humble, listening patience, as if the next word might matter more than anything else.

people.imagined: Late afternoon in the Tower's stores, counting jars. His lips move as someone passes outside. A neat, forgettable man, he has counted everything and kept two ledgers; he wishes only to die in bed in the Pivot's city.
people.subject: The moment: late afternoon in the Tower's stores, a man of fifty-five counting jars; his lips move as someone passes outside. He has counted everything and kept two ledgers, and wishes only to die in bed in the Pivot's city. Face: most important, his lips are caught moving, forming silent numbers, and his eyes slide sideways, watchful and wary, within a perfectly plain, unmemorable face; a neat, pale, middle-aged face with thin mouse-brown brows, a small straight nose and a small pursed mouth. Hair: thinning brown, combed flat into a neat small knot under a plain black gauze cap with a dull silver pin. Body: slight, neat, narrow-shouldered, buttoned up to the throat. Clothing: an administrator's immaculate robe of grey-violet silk with crossed collars buttoned high, wide sleeves with spotless cuffs embroidered in thin silver thread, a black gauze over-robe folded over one arm, a black sash with a small jade seal hanging from it. Hands and objects: the right forefinger touches a ceramic jar on the shelf, the middle finger showing a shiny ink callus; a small string abacus of dark wood is held in the left hand. Background: a blurred shelf of identical jars, a lamp, a doorway of grey rain and drifting mist. Light: dim warm lantern-light from the upper left, a cool grey spirit-glow from the doorway touching the jar rims. Expression: neutral and careful, a slight fearfulness in the held breath, the face of a man who has counted everything and wishes only to be left alone.

people.imagined: A midday at the new seat. He is big and easy, a bamboo staff on his shoulder, in his green Xuyên Lâm tunic under a borrowed black cloak. He has waited thirty years as a surety and does not want to be thanked.
people.subject: The moment: midday at the new seat, a big easy man of forty-five with a bamboo staff on his shoulder, in his green Xuyên Lâm tunic under a borrowed black Thunder cloak; he has waited thirty years as a surety and does not want to be thanked. Face: most important, the borrowed black gauze over-robe, too short in the sleeve, worn over a bright green silk tunic with a rolled collar, the green clearly showing at the neck and wrists; a big, easy, round, sun-brown face with kind brown eyes and deep laugh lines, thick brows, a broad nose, a wide mouth in a half smile and a short grey-streaked beard. Hair: black with grey, tied in a short tail with a green silk cord and a small jade pin. Body: big and broad, a thick-chested wanderer's frame, shoulders loose. Clothing: a flowing green silk robe of his old home in two crossed collars with embroidered bamboo-leaf borders, a borrowed black over-robe with silver lightning at the hem, a grey sash hung with a green jade bead, a straw hat hanging at his back by its cord. Hands and objects: a long bamboo staff, pale green and jointed, held over the right shoulder in the right hand; the left hand open at his side, relaxed. Power: a few pale-gold motes of metal-light and soft green wisps of wood qi drift lazily from the staff. Background: a blurred ridge, misty trees and a pale sky. Light: soft spirit-lit daylight from the upper left, warm on his face with a gentle rim glow. Expression: friendly and easy, with a quiet homesickness in the eyes behind the half smile.

people.imagined: Evening at the new seat, ringing the evening bell. Her palms bear bell-rope callus. A solid freckled woman who has carried her master's letters and read one.
people.subject: The moment: evening at the new seat, a solid freckled woman of forty-five ringing the evening bell, face lowered; she has carried her master's letters and read one. Face: most important, both palms carry thick yellow callus ridges from the bell-rope, shown in the hands at the lower frame, and her freckled face is lowered; a solid, plain, rosy round face with small steady light brown eyes, straight sandy brows, a short nose spattered with freckles and a wide closed mouth. Hair: sandy-brown with grey, plaited and pinned flat, a band of grey running back from each temple and a loose ginger curl behind one ear, a plain dark silver hairpin. Body: solid, strong, thick through the waist, planted. Clothing: a fine robe of storm-grey silk with crossed collars of black and violet, sleeves tied back with silver cord, a long black gauze over-robe pinned off the arms, the hem let down and neatly stitched with three rows of tiny stitches, a sash with a small bronze bell at the belt. Hands and objects: both hands wrapped round a hemp bell-rope that rises out of the frame; slung across her back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword whose steel gives back a faint violet cast, its grip wrapped in plaited hemp like a bell-rope, a round guard of dark bronze, a black lacquered scabbard with a bronze band, and a small bell at the pommel stuffed with wool. Power: faint violet sparks run along the rope as the bell hums. Background: a blurred stone bell tower in the dusk, a warm window, drifting mist. Light: soft amber evening light from the upper left, gilding the freckles. Expression: faithful, quiet and burdened.

people.imagined: Dawn at the outer gate, the Kinh Trập bell test. A stooped, kindly man uses a herder's crook as a pointer. He has rung eighty springs, and remembers the one year it did not answer him.
people.subject: The moment: dawn at the outer gate at the Kinh Trập bell test, a stooped, kindly man of sixty using a herder's crook as a pointer; he has rung eighty springs and remembers the one year the bell did not answer him. Face: most important, the long wooden herder's crook with its curved hook in his raised hand, used like a pointer; a stooped, kindly man's long, soft, leathery brown face creased with smile lines, mild dark eyes, thin white bushy brows, a broad nose, a kind mouth slightly open as if explaining and a white beard. Hair: white and thin, in a small topknot under a dark gauze cap with a silver pin. Body: stooped, thin and long-armed. Clothing: an old steward's flowing robe of grey and storm-violet silk in layers with crossed collars, wide sleeves and cuffs embroidered with small silver bells, a neat black gauze over-robe, a cord belt hung with a small wooden whistle and a jade bead, sandals tied with new cord. Hands and objects: the crook held out in the right hand, its hook worn pale and smooth and its shaft notched with one mark for each year the bell has rung; the left hand cupped behind his ear; a big bronze bell hangs from a post behind him. A well-made long straight sword, its grip wrapped in faded straw hemp, a crescent guard of grey iron, a scuffed brown-black scabbard with a horn chape, is slung diagonally across his back. Power: a faint ring of golden-white sound-light shimmers round the bronze bell. Background: a gate of grey timber, mist and a pale dawn. Light: soft pale dawn spirit-light from the upper left with a low rosy glow on the white beard and the bronze. Expression: gentle and patient, the warm teacherly look of a man who has done this eighty springs and still listens for the one that did not answer.

people.imagined: A hard morning on a duelling ground. He has just won his thirty-first duel and looks at his sleeve, where two red names are stitched, wanting a third. His nose is a hawk's.
people.subject: The moment: a hard morning on a duelling ground, a man of forty who has just won his thirty-first duel and looks at his sleeve, where two red names are stitched, wanting a third. Face: most important, a sharp hooked hawk's nose, and, held forward and plainly visible, the left sleeve of his robe carrying two names stitched in bright red thread, drawn as small red marks rather than writing; a hard, lean face with dark, narrow, glittering eyes, heavy straight black brows, a long thin jaw and a thin, hard, level mouth. Hair: black, tied in a tight topknot with a black iron pin and a narrow silver crown. Body: lean, rangy and tall, in a duellist's coiled stance. Clothing: a fine duelling robe of black and storm-violet silk with a high crossed collar and tight sleeves, the left sleeve bearing the two red stitched marks, a long black gauze over-robe thrown back from the shoulders with silver lightning along the edge, a black sash with a dark jade pendant. Hands and objects: his right hand rests on the hilt of a plain sword in a black scabbard at his hip; the left arm is bent upward to show the sleeve. Power: a cold gleam of white-gold metal light runs the length of the scabbard and fine glinting motes of steel drift off his shoulders. Background: a pale wet stone ground, a few blurred watchers, slanting rain in mist. Light: cold grey spirit-light from the upper left, shining on wet stone and the black silk. Expression: hard, proud and hungry, a stare with no warmth in it, like a hawk watching the next opening.

people.imagined: Late night, the lamp low, a book open on her knees, her sword sheathed beside her. She has read the righteous manual every night since 1150 and her sword has grown gentler than the Tower likes. Ink on her cuffs.
people.subject: The moment: late at night with the lamp low, a woman of forty reading a book open on her knees with her sword sheathed beside her; she has read the righteous manual every night since 1150 and her sword has grown gentler than the Tower likes. Face: most important, black ink stains on both pale cuffs, bold dark smudges, and the sheathed sword laid at her side; a quiet, calm, oval face, pale and clear, with gentle dark eyes shadowed from reading, fine level brows, a straight nose, a soft closed mouth with a trace of a smile and a tiny ink smudge on one cheek. Hair: black, parted in the middle and tied low at the nape with a grey silk ribbon and a thin jade pin. Body: slim, upright, gentle. Clothing: a robe of soft grey and storm-violet silk in two crossed collars, wide sleeves finished with ink-stained pale linen cuffs, a black gauze over-robe folded beside her, silver raindrop embroidery at the hem, a black sash with a jade pendant. Hands and objects: a thin old book with a blue cover, open in her left hand; her right hand rests on a plain sword in a black scabbard across her lap. Power: a gentle glow of pale green wood-light and a few soft motes of metal gold rise from the page and the scabbard. Background: a dim room, a low lamp, a cupboard door ajar, rain on the window, a soft mist. Light: warm lamplight from the lower left, cool dark blue spirit-light behind. Expression: gentle, absorbed, compassionate.

people.imagined: The ferry inn at Thu Trì, rainy evening. She wears her rain-cap even under the roof, never asking a guest's name. Her palms keep the grooves of ferry rope. She sends everything up to Nhiếp.
people.subject: The moment: the ferry inn at Thu Trì on a rainy evening, a woman of forty-five pouring tea; she never asks a guest's name and sends everything up to Nhiếp. Face: most important, a conical straw rain-cap worn even indoors, pulled low, its shadow across her brow, its cord tied under the chin with a flat knot; a square, stolid, weathered face with narrow pale grey watching eyes, a lined brow, a straight nose, a thin patient closed mouth with deep lines round it, a faint scar across the chin and short pale lashes. Hair: grey, tucked up under the cap, one grey plait hanging over the left shoulder. Body: stout, broad-shouldered, a landlady's solidity. Clothing: a thick but graceful robe of storm-grey and black silk with crossed collars and wide sleeves pushed above the wrist, a long black gauze over-robe worn open, silver raindrop embroidery at the cuffs, a dark violet sash hung with a lead ferry token on a jade bead. Hands and objects: she pours from a heavy clay teapot into a bowl, the palms and fingers showing deep grooves from ferry rope; slung across the back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword with faint beads of damp on the steel, its grip wrapped in tarred ferry-rope hemp, a flat oval guard of dark pewter, a waxed grey scabbard with a rope loop. Power: pale blue water-qi gathers in the steam of the tea and drifts in slow wisps. Background: a blurred inn room with a low table and benches, a window of grey rain, a hanging lamp. Light: warm lamp light from the upper left, soft silver spirit-light of rain beyond, an amber pool under her cap's brim. Expression: guarded, patient, courteous.

people.imagined: Drilling in the Thu Trì rain at dawn. He wants the sword, not the abacus. He grins like a stall-keeper when he forgets himself. His thumb is a swordsman's.
people.subject: The moment: drilling in the Thu Trì rain at dawn, a man of thirty who wants the sword, not the abacus, and grins like a stall-keeper when he forgets himself. Face: most important, a wide, bright stall-keeper's grin, all teeth, breaking through the stern drill face, and a heavy callus ridge on the thumb of his sword hand; a round, friendly, rain-wet brown face, open and quick, with bright brown eyes, thick brows, a snub nose, a wide mouth and a little white scar on the chin from a childhood abacus bite; water drips from his brow and nose. Hair: black, plastered wet, tied in a short tail with a dark silver clasp. Body: sturdy, broad and light on his feet, feet set wide on wet cobbles, sword arm straight and the shoulder low. Clothing: a disciple's robe of storm-grey silk with black and violet crossed collars, wide sleeves tied back, a black gauze over-robe thrown back and soaked, silver raindrops embroidered at the cuffs, a sash with a bronze bell, a straw hat on his back. Hands and objects: a plain sword held up in the right hand, the thumb thick with a swordsman's callus; the other hand open in a stance. Power: a pale shimmer of water-blue and metal-white light runs along the wet blade and rain-droplets float round it. Background: grey rain and mist, closed market stalls blurred behind him with wet awnings and a swinging lantern, a tiny figure that might be his father in a doorway. Light: cold silver dawn spirit-light from the upper left, a gleam on the wet blade. Expression: earnest, then a sudden big grin.

people.imagined: The foundry at Tử Kim Khoáng. She tilts her head to a bronze cup she has just cast, tuning by ear. She is the forge master's daughter and calm.
people.subject: The moment: the foundry at Tử Kim Khoáng, a calm woman of forty tilting her head to a bronze cup she has just cast, tuning by ear; she is the forge master's daughter. Face: most important, her head tilted hard to one side toward a small bronze rain-cup held at her ear, and a pensive half-smile; a calm, square-jawed, strong, tanned face with thoughtful half-closed dark eyes, heavy straight brows, a straight nose, a mild closed mouth, a smear of bronze dust on the chin and large fine-shaped ears cupped slightly forward as if always listening. Hair: black, in a thick knot with a bronze pin and a silver comb, short strands stuck to her nape with sweat. Body: strong, broad-shouldered and sturdy. Clothing: a robe of black and storm-violet silk with wide sleeves tied back by a silver cord, two crossed collars, a long black gauze over-robe scorched a little at the hem, silver lightning and small bell borders, a black sash hung with a bronze-cup pendant. Hands and objects: the left hand holds a bright bronze cup, shaped like a small bell, beside her ear; the right holds a slim iron tapping rod; slung across her back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword with a faint violet temper-line, its grip covered in black ray-skin, a guard cast in dark bronze, a slate-grey lacquered scabbard and a small bronze rain-chain cup of her own casting for a pommel. Power: a bell-like ring of gold-white light and faint violet sparks hangs round the cup. Background: an orange-lit foundry in mist, eleven finished cups of descending size hanging in a row on cords on a rack behind her, each a slightly different gold. Light: warm orange glow from the right, bronze highlights, a rim of spirit-light. Expression: head tilted toward the cup, eyes half closed in attention, a calm and quietly content mouth.

people.imagined: Beside the lake in the rain, still as a heron. The rain collects in her sleeves. She has learned the names of the dead in the lake.
people.subject: The moment: beside the lake in the rain, a woman of thirty-five as still as a heron; the rain collects in her sleeves, and she has learned the names of the dead in the lake. Face: most important, her wide black sleeves drip steadily with rainwater, water running off the cuffs in threads, and she stands utterly still; a narrow, pale, tranquil oval face, wet, with calm grey-green eyes, fine arched brows, a long straight nose, a small calm mouth, drops of rain on her lashes and pale lips. Hair: black, in a low bun with a single white lotus petal tucked in and a pale silver pin. Body: tall, thin, straight-necked, her weight on one leg, the other foot lifted slightly like a wading heron. Clothing: layered robes of black and pale storm-blue silk with two crossed collars, enormously wide black gauze sleeves dripping, silver raindrop and lotus embroidery along the borders, a sash with a pale jade pendant, a straw hat hanging back. Hands and objects: both hands folded in her wet sleeves; one pale withered lotus stem rises from the lake at her side; past the right shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a well-made long straight sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Power: pale blue water-qi rises in fine mist from her sleeves and small luminous droplets hang in the air round her. Background: a grey lake with rain rings, withered lotus leaves and a pale mist. Light: soft cool silver spirit-light from the upper left, a pale shimmer on the lake and a faint rim of light on her shoulders. Expression: a serene, still face with lowered eyes, rain on her lashes, a soft closed mouth and a humble, listening quiet.

people.imagined: The soul vault, lamps in rows. She writes a name on a new lamp, pale as wax. The vault boys swear she casts no shadow. She keeps her own list of every lamp that has gone out.
people.subject: The moment: the soul vault with lamps in rows, a woman of forty writing a name on a new lamp, pale as wax; the vault boys swear she casts no shadow, and she keeps her own list of every lamp that has gone out. Face: most important, her skin is pale as candle wax, and the light behind her throws no shadow on the wall; a pale, oval, wax-white face with large dark lowered eyes, thin fine brows, a narrow nose, a small pale mouth almost the colour of her skin and fine blue veins at the temple and in the hollow of the throat. Hair: black, in a smooth coil pinned with a thin silver pin and a small pale jade comb. Body: slight, narrow and thin. Clothing: layered robes of grey and storm-violet silk with two crossed collars, ink-dark wide cuffs embroidered with silver lightning thread, a long black gauze over-robe folded beside her, a high collar, a black sash hung with a small pale lamp-charm. Hands and objects: a small round clay lamp with a cloth shade held in the left hand, a fine brush in the right; behind her rows of identical small lamps on shelves, a few lit, most dark; on a low table at her elbow lies a second thin book tied with black thread, closed. Power: the lit lamps burn with thin tongues of red and violet-white spirit-fire and a faint pallor of cold qi clings to her fingers. Background: a dim vault of shelves of lamps in mist, a pale wall without shadow. Light: a small warm lamp glow from below lighting only her chin and the underside of her nose, with deep spirit-blue shadow above. Expression: quiet, reclusive, careful.

people.imagined: The market behind the counter. He sticks out a green-tinged tongue as a guarantee to a customer, a callous, patient grin. He sells his own poisons.
people.subject: The moment: the market behind the counter, a young man of twenty-five sticking out a green-tinged tongue as a guarantee to a customer, a callous, patient grin; he sells his own poisons. Face: most important, a long, stuck-out tongue stained a vivid pale green all over, and green stains round the lips; a lean, narrow, sallow face with small, sly, yellow-brown eyes, thin straight brows, a hooked nose and a wide mouth open in a grin, the front teeth tinted faintly green and a thin green line along the lower lip. Hair: black, greasy and lank, tied up with a silver string and a dark jade pin. Body: lean, narrow, slouching, his weight on his elbows over the counter, the head thrust forward like a heron's, the narrow shoulders hunched. Clothing: a fine robe of grey and storm-violet silk, a little showy, stained green at the cuffs, with crossed collars and wide sleeves, a clean black gauze over-robe with silver embroidered borders, a row of little stoppered jade and glass bottles on a silk cord at his chest. Hands and objects: both hands flat on a market counter, the fingertips stained green; before him a small row of glass vials of different liquids. Power: thin curls of pale green wood-qi and a faint poisonous haze rise from the vials and drift round his hands. Background: a blurred market stall with hanging dried herbs and frogs, a lantern, rain in mist. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, with sharp moving shadows across the counter and a sickly spirit-green glow on his tongue. Expression: sly, cheerful, callous.

people.imagined: The storm drill on the peak, drum in hand, shouting. A drum-skin tattooed round one forearm. He flogs the last boy or the third as the drum decides.
people.subject: The moment: the storm drill on the peak, a man of forty-five shouting, a drumstick in hand; he flogs the last boy or the third as the drum decides. Face: most important, a drum-skin pattern tattooed in black rings round his bare right forearm, plainly visible as he swings the drumstick, and a roaring mouth; a thick, red, bearded face with small, fierce, pale eyes, heavy down-slanted brows, a boxer's nose, a wide shouting mouth full of broken teeth, a thick grey beard, deep furrows from nose to chin and a vein standing on the temple. Hair: grey, cropped short, a black silk cloth bound round the head with a silver clasp. Body: stocky, thick-necked, shoulders like a bull. Clothing: a drillmaster's robe of black and storm-violet silk with a crossed collar and the sleeves cut away on the right arm, a black gauze over-robe scorched at the hem and unmended, pinned back at the shoulder, a black sash with a bronze buckle. Hands and objects: a dark wooden drumstick held up in the right hand, the tattooed forearm bare; a flat barrel drum with a taut painted ring hangs at his belt, rain streaming off it; slung across the back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made narrow straight sword, its grip bound in pale drum-skin, a squared bar guard of black iron, an ink-black scabbard and a rawhide thong at the pommel. Power: with each strike violet-white lightning flickers along the drumstick and rings of pale sound-light spread from the drum. Background: dark storm clouds, a lightning flash, a ridge in mist. Light: cold white spirit-light from the upper left; each flash picks out the tattooed rings like carved lines. Expression: mouth wide open mid-shout, teeth bared, brows slammed down, veins standing in his neck, eyes blazing and wild.

people.imagined: Under the eaves of the old tower in the rain, singing to the founder's chain, a green ribbon round her wrist. She chose to stay when her year went east.
people.subject: The moment: under the eaves of the old tower in the rain, a woman of forty singing to the founder's chain with a green ribbon round her wrist; she chose to stay when her year went east. Face: most important, a bright green ribbon knotted round her raised wrist, vivid against the black and grey; a round, open, kindly, fair and flushed face with bright dark eyes closed in song, soft brows, a small nose, a wide open mouth with a small gap between the front teeth and cheeks rosy with the damp air. Hair: dark brown, in a long loose braid tied at the end with green thread, beads of rain sitting like pearls along it, a loose curl at the temple and a small silver hairpin. Body: slim, upright and soft-shouldered, chest lifted and chin up as she sings, throat bare to the eaves. Clothing: flowing robes of black and storm-violet silk with two crossed collars, a black gauze over-robe worn open, wide sleeves with silver raindrop embroidery sliding back from the lifted arm, a high collar, a black sash hung with a green jade bead. Hands and objects: the right hand lifted high with the green ribbon at the wrist; at the edge, a long bronze chain of small cups hangs from the eaves with water running down it; a well-made narrow straight sword in a blue-black scabbard is slung diagonally across her back, its pewter guard and pale-blue cord grip above the right shoulder. Power: soft ripples of silver and pale blue light follow the sound of her voice along the chain. Background: a grey tower eave, slanting rain, a blurred forest in mist. Light: soft silver spirit-light from the upper left, sliding along the wet bronze cups. Expression: content, open and joyful.

people.imagined: Evening in the dining hall of the new seat, wine going round, the Thunder Hall muttering about him. He sits stiffly with violet dust in his cuffs and a faint, stubborn lift of the chin.
people.subject: The moment: evening in the dining hall of the new seat with wine going round, a man of thirty-two sitting stiffly while the Thunder Hall mutters about him, a faint stubborn lift of his chin. Face: most important, his cuffs and the heels of his hands are ground with fine amethyst-violet dust that sparkles; a lean, handsome, serious young face with dark brows, level dark eyes, a straight nose, a firm closed mouth, short stubble, a faint line of fatigue under each eye and a tiny scar in the left eyebrow from the mine. Hair: black, tied in a high tail with a black cord and a small amethyst bead, a few strands loose at the neck. Body: tall, rangy, upright. Clothing: a true disciple's robe of storm-grey and violet silk with two crossed collars and wide sleeves, a black gauze over-robe with scorched hems and silver lightning borders, a black sash, a small violet crystal pendant; the violet dust glitters in the cuffs. Hands and objects: both hands on the table, the dust showing in the knuckle creases, a bowl of rice before him; slung across his back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword with a thin violet shimmer along the edge, its grip wrapped in slate-grey silk cord with fine amethyst grit worked in, a rounded-square guard of dark steel and a black lacquered scabbard. Power: a thin violet-white lightning glow clings to his cuffs and the blade's hilt, steady and restrained. Background: a blurred dim hall in mist, lamps, two Thunder Hall men behind him with their backs turned, one lifting a wine cup. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left, a faint violet spirit-gleam at his cuffs. Expression: stubborn, proud, hurt and steady.

people.imagined: At the mine tally shed, a heated argument over a count. A ledger sticks from his belt. He leans in with red knuckles, ready to break a third arm.
people.subject: The moment: the mine tally shed in a heated argument over a count, a man of thirty-eight leaning in with red knuckles, ready to break a third arm. Face: most important, a white scar slashes straight through his left eyebrow, splitting the brow in two, and his knuckles are red and swollen; a square, hard, flushed face with dark, glaring eyes, a broken nose, a thick tight mouth, a short black beard with violet stone dust sparkling in the stubble. Hair: black, cropped, with a strand of grey at the temple. Body: stocky, heavy-shouldered, pushed forward. Clothing: a robe of black and storm-violet silk with a crossed collar and sleeves tied back, a black gauze over-robe worn open and dusted with violet, silver lightning on the cuffs, a thick cloth-covered ledger pushed into a heavy black sash with an iron buckle from which a small hammer for testing stone hangs. Hands and objects: both fists planted on the counter, knuckles red and scraped, a chunk of violet thunder-glass the size of a fist beside them; slung across his back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made slim jian, its grip wrapped in scuffed brown leather, a round guard of dull pewter dented on one side, and a hard black horn-faced scabbard with its throat chipped. Power: a crackle of violet lightning runs inside the thunder-glass and sparks leap from his knuckles. Background: a blurred timber mine shed, lamps, tools in a haze of dust. Light: a hard slice of spirit-light from the door puts a bright edge along the knuckles and the violet glass. Expression: belligerent, hard-set, touchy.

people.imagined: The coast house at Lãng Hoa, dusk. She sits sideways at a table, never with her back to the window, a key on a cord at her chest. Salt dries in her hair. She has made a bargain north she is not telling anyone.
people.subject: The moment: the coast house at Lãng Hoa at dusk, a woman of forty sitting sideways at a table, never with her back to the window; she has made a bargain north she is not telling anyone. Face: most important, a heavy iron key on a leather cord hanging over her chest, held between two fingers, and a grey-white crust of dried salt in her black hair; a clever, handsome, brown face, sharp at the cheekbones, with dark, shrewd, half-lidded eyes, arched brows, a slim nose, a closed amused mouth and a thread of dried salt at the left temple. Hair: black, loosely bound in a knot, streaked with white salt, a single pearl hairpin glinting. Body: slim, upright, one shoulder turned, her back to the wall and her face to the window. Clothing: flowing robes of black and sea-blue silk with two crossed collars, a long black gauze over-robe spotted with salt, wide sleeves embroidered at the cuffs with silver waves and lightning, a black sash with a pearl pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts a big iron house key on its cord; the left rests by a small clay cup; slung across her back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made slim jian with a round guard in a blue-black scabbard, the grip wrapped in pale blue cord, a pewter guard. Power: pale blue water-qi and a few silver motes drift round her shoulders like sea spray. Background: a window with a dusky grey sea and masts, a lamp, a map of the coast pinned on the wall with small red marks, a narrow shelf of shells. Light: cool blue dusk spirit-light from the window, warm lamp glow from the lower left. Expression: wary, amused, calculating.

people.imagined: Sorting pebbles at the mine mouth, he holds one flower-shaped stone to the light. A cough follows from a boy beside him; he is counting stones, not boys.
people.subject: The moment: sorting pebbles at the mine mouth, a man of fifty holding one flower-shaped stone to the light; a cough follows from a boy beside him, but he is counting stones, not boys. Face: most important, a small flower-shaped pebble, pale pink and white like a cherry blossom, held at eye level, and fine pebble dust on his sleeves; a dry, narrow, lined face with small, pale, weighing eyes, sparse brows, a long nose, thin lips in a calculating line and a trimmed grey goatee. Hair: iron grey, in a topknot under a tiny dark gauze cap dusted with mine dust and a dull silver pin, the temples sharply combed. Body: spare, upright and fussy, feet together, elbows close to the ribs, a whole stance of cold exactness. Clothing: a steward's robe of grey-violet silk with crossed collars, wide sleeves dusted pale, silver lightning at the cuffs, a black gauze over-robe folded neatly over one arm, a black sash with a pouch of pebbles. Hands and objects: the right hand lifts the flower-stone; the left holds a flat wooden tray with rows of small round stones; slung across his back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword, its grip wrapped in grey-brown hemp, a guard cut in a plain five-lobed flower outline from dark iron, a slate-grey hide scabbard and a small flower-shaped pebble in a cord net at the pommel. Power: the flower-stone gives off a faint pale gold metal glimmer and a few cool motes drift from the tray. Background: a wet mine mouth, dark rock in mist; in its shadow a small thin boy in a wet shirt sits coughing into a hand, only half visible. Light: cold grey spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: precise, cool, uncaring.

people.imagined: A night vigil by the water clock, head cocked to the drip. Dark under-eyes. He reports every lamp he sees lit.
people.subject: The moment: a night vigil by the water clock, a young man of twenty-eight with his head cocked to the drip; he reports every lamp he sees lit. Face: most important, one deep bruise-purple shadow under the eye, hollow with sleeplessness, and the head cocked sharply to the left; a thin, pale young face with wide light eyes, thin brows, a narrow nose, a small tight mouth and stubble. Hair: dark brown, tied in a short tail with a grey cord and a plain silver pin, a few loose strands falling in his eyes. Body: thin, stooped, alert, sitting cross-legged on a straw mat with the spine curved forward and one ear a hand's width nearer the clock. Clothing: a robe of grey and storm-violet silk with crossed collars, cuffs folded back with tiny ink flecks on the right sleeve, a black gauze over-robe around his shoulders with silver raindrop borders, a black sash with a small jade pendant, a soft silk scarf wound twice round his neck against the chill. Hands and objects: a small notebook and brush held in the left hand; the right finger lifted as if counting drips. Power: a faint pale-gold thread of metal qi hangs round his lifted finger and each falling drop leaves a tiny ring of silver light. Background: a dim hall in mist, a tall brass-and-clay water clock dripping, a single lamp. Light: a low yellow lamp from the right, with a single drop catching the lamplight like a bead, and a thin spirit-blue rim. Expression: intent, tired, watchful.

people.imagined: On the ridge road, about to turn a corner, she blows a reed whistle first. She was born below the old tower and carried east as a child.
people.subject: The moment: on the ridge road about to turn a corner, a woman of thirty-five blowing a reed whistle first; she was born below the old tower and carried east as a child. Face: most important, a thin reed whistle on a thong between her lips, the thong swinging, and flushed running cheeks; a quick, narrow, wind-roughened brown face with bright dark eyes looking ahead, sharp brows, a pointed nose, chapped lips round the whistle, a line of sweat at the hairline and a small nick in the left ear. Hair: black, in a long braid flying behind with a silver ribbon. Body: lean, light, a runner's frame, on the balls of her feet with elbows tucked and the body leaning ahead of her legs. Clothing: a short robe of storm-grey silk hitched up for running with two crossed collars, a short black gauze cape fluttering from the shoulders with silver lightning at the edge, a black sash knotted up on one side to free the knee, soft silk boots bound with cord and spattered with ridge mud, a leather message satchel across the chest. Hands and objects: the left hand holds the satchel strap; the right holds the whistle's thong; a well-made narrow light sword, its grip wrapped in thin black silk cord, a slim bar guard of black iron with upturned ends and a lacquered split-bamboo scabbard held with two cross-straps, is slung diagonally across her back, its hilt showing above the right shoulder. Power: a trail of pale gold-white motes and a faint wind-whirl of qi streams behind her heels. Background: a misty ridge road, wet stones, dark pines. Light: soft grey spirit-light from the upper left, a sliver of pale sun on the dew. Expression: brisk, alert, urgent.

people.imagined: Night walk along the Iron Rain chain, listening to a guard lie to him. He does not blink. A fern-shaped lightning scar runs down his wrist.
people.subject: The moment: a night walk along the Iron Rain chain, a man of thirty-eight listening to a guard lie to him; he does not blink. Face: most important, a pale branching lightning scar like a fern frond runs down the inside of his right wrist and onto the hand, held up near his chest, and he does not blink; a hard, lean, sun-browned face with dark eyes and a flat gaze, heavy brows, a long straight nose, a thin level mouth, stubble, a fine web of thin burn-lines at the eye corners and dry cracked lips. Hair: black, short and bristly. Body: lean, tall, loose and still, standing square to the viewer with the arms relaxed and the weight perfectly balanced, ready for either a bolt or a blow. Clothing: a robe of black and storm-violet silk with crossed collars and tied-back sleeves, a long black gauze over-robe scorched along the hem into a fringe like a crow's feathers from old strikes, silver lightning at the borders, a black sash, a brass-studded bracer guarding the left wrist. Hands and objects: the right wrist and hand lifted into view, the scar pale against the brown skin; the left rests on the hilt of a plain sword. Power: the scar glows faintly violet-white and fine arcs of lightning crawl between his fingers and the nearest iron rods. Background: a night ridge, a row of tall iron rods against a dark sky with distant flashes, mist. Light: cold blue-white spirit-light from the upper left, with a flicker of lightning. Expression: cold, unblinking and testing, the flat patience of someone waiting for a lie to finish.

people.imagined: Guarding the old tower's stair, leaning on a boat-pole in a ferryman's wide-footed stance.
people.subject: The moment: guarding the old tower's stair, a woman of twenty-eight leaning on a boat-pole in a ferryman's wide-footed stance. Face: most important, a long wooden boat-pole with an iron shoe, held upright, and a wide-footed ferryman's stance; a strong, wide, brown face with a big jaw, bright, level, dark eyes, strong straight brows, a snub nose, a wide mouth with a calm, ready half-smile, tiny freckles on the nose and a small pale scar curving along one eyebrow. Hair: short black, cropped at the nape, a green silk cloth tied round the brow with a thin tail drifting over her collar. Body: broad-shouldered, strong, low and steady. Clothing: a robe of storm-grey and black silk with crossed collars, wide sleeves, trousers of grey silk tucked into wrapped silk legs, a black gauze over-robe thrown back with silver raindrop embroidery, a black sash with a jade bead, a plain sword in a scabbard at her hip. Hands and objects: both hands on the boat-pole, one above the other, its end resting on stone steps. Power: a soft pale blue water-qi gathers like mist round the iron shoe and a few motes of silver light rise from the stair. Background: a grey old stone stair, mist, a bronze rain-chain hanging. Light: soft grey spirit-light from the upper left, a glimmer of damp on the stone steps giving the iron shoe a dull shine. Expression: steady, calm, a ferryman's patience.

people.imagined: After a storm drill, dressing a burn. Her apron carries every salve in the Tower; she smells of camphor.
people.subject: The moment: after a storm drill, a woman of forty-two dressing a burn; she smells of camphor and her apron carries every salve in the Tower. Face: most important, a long apron stitched all over with small pockets, each holding a little pot or jar, filling the lower frame over her robes; a round, motherly, kind face with warm brown eyes with fine crow's feet, soft level brows, a small round nose, a gentle closed mouth and a small crease between her brows as she studies the wound. Hair: grey-streaked black, coiled in a bun beneath a white head-cloth fastened with a small jade pin. Body: round, solid and comfortable, bent at the waist with her weight on one foot, both hands working at once. Clothing: a healer's robe of soft dove and storm-violet silk with crossed collars, sleeves tied back with silver cord, a long black gauze over-robe hung on a hook behind, a pocketed apron of fine pale cloth embroidered with small green leaves, a black sash. Hands and objects: the right fingers dipped in green salve; the left holds a small open pot of the salve, with a roll of bandage in a pocket. Power: a soft green wood-light rises from the salve in slow wisps, with a few pale gold motes of healing qi settling on the burn. Background: a blurred infirmary shelf with jars, a bed, a window of rain, a drift of herbal steam. Light: soft warm lamp-light from the upper left, a thin line of silver spirit-light from the window showing steam rising from a basin. Expression: kind, calm and capable.

people.imagined: In the dining hall, saying loudly that her master should be head, one finger on the silver pin in her hair, the gesture she makes when she wants to be believed.
people.subject: The moment: in the dining hall, a woman of thirty saying loudly that her master should be head, one finger on the silver pin in her hair, the gesture she makes when she wants to be believed. Face: most important, a long, bright silver hairpin with a flat leaf-shaped end, touched by her fingers, set in her black hair; a pretty, soft, earnest, fair round face with wide, sincere, dark eyes, delicate high brows, a small nose, a small soft mouth slightly open, a faint blush and a tiny beauty spot at the outer corner of the left eye. Hair: black, in a high knot pinned with the silver pin. Body: slim, upright, eager, leaning slightly forward with her hands near her chest in the open posture of someone sure she is right. Clothing: a robe of grey and storm-violet silk with a high crossed collar, wide sleeves, a black gauze over-robe with silver lightning borders, a black sash with a pale jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right hand raised to touch the silver pin; the left holds a bowl of rice; slung across the back past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made straight double-edged sword with a faint dew-sheen on the steel, its grip wrapped in pale grey silk, a slender double-crescent guard, a black lacquered scabbard with a thin line of silver wire round the mouth, and a tiny silver bead on the tassel cord. Power: a faint shimmer of silver-blue water light gathers round the pin and the sword hilt. Background: a blurred dining hall in mist, tables, lamps, three disciples with bowls looking down, one of them a young man with violet dust at his cuffs. Light: warm lamplight from the upper left with a soft spirit-glow along her cheek. Expression: sincere, eager, a trace of calculation.

people.imagined: On the guardhouse wall in a storm, bareheaded, his grandfather's stance to the inch.
people.subject: The moment: on the guardhouse wall in a storm, a man of forty-two bareheaded, holding his grandfather's stance to the inch. Face: most important, a bare, rain-soaked, uncovered head, no hat, and the stance held to the inch; a broad, heavy, stern, wet brown face with narrow dark eyes squinting into the rain, thick brows, a broad flat nose, a thin hard mouth, a short black beard, rain running in lines off the brows and nose and lips blue with cold. Hair: black, plastered flat to the skull. Body: huge, broad and solid as a gatepost. Clothing: a robe of black and storm-violet silk, open over a grey inner robe with a crossed collar and a black sash with a bronze buckle, a long black gauze over-robe of good cloth whose hem is scorched in a saw-tooth line of black and brown by old strikes and left unmended on purpose, silver lightning at the cuffs, no hat. Hands and objects: arms crossed over his chest, bare forearms thick with rain, knuckles white where each hand grips the opposite elbow; a tall iron rod rises behind his shoulder and his feet are planted a shoulder-width apart on the wet stone; slung across his back past the right shoulder rises the hilt of a well-made long straight sword, its grip covered in dark-grey sharkskin, a heavy squared plate guard of black iron with a blue-grey scorch tint, and an old black leather scabbard scorch-marked at its lower end and never mended, a faint violet gleam in the steel. Power: violet-white lightning gathers on the iron rod and flickers over the sword hilt, the metal motes of his gold-white qi shimmering in the air. Background: dark storm clouds, a stone wall, a forked flash of lightning. Light: cold white spirit-light from the upper left, with flashes. Expression: stoic, steadfast and unmoved, a stone face that the storm cannot reach.

people.imagined: Arriving with letters, a worn-through satchel at her hip. She is already telling you about the meal she ate at Hồng Đậu Trang and lived.
people.subject: The moment: arriving with letters on a muddy road, a woman of thirty already telling you about the meal she ate at Hồng Đậu Trang and lived. Face: most important, a leather satchel with one corner worn through so a letter peeks out, hung at her hip, and a wide boasting grin; a lively, round, freckled, wind-tanned face with bright, sparkling brown eyes, quick raised brows, a snub nose, a big grin, a damp curl on each cheek and a feather from a hen caught in one plait. Hair: dark brown, in two short plaits under a straw rain hat pushed back, with a small silver ribbon. Body: small, quick and light, walking with a springy bounce, the satchel swinging and the whole body pitched forward to talk. Clothing: a short robe of storm-grey silk with two crossed collars, a short black gauze cape with silver raindrops at the hem, a black sash with a small bronze bell, silk boots caked with red road mud to the ankle and a fresh careless splash on the hem. Hands and objects: the right hand holds a folded letter sealed with a plain blob of wax; the left hand grips the satchel strap; past the left shoulder rises the pale blue-corded hilt of a well-made long straight sword slung on the back, its blue-black scabbard held by a plain strap, the blade of blue-grey steel. Power: a quick scatter of pale blue and silver motes hops round her heels like water droplets. Background: a muddy road, a grey sky in mist, a manor gate in the distance. Light: soft spirit-lit daylight from the upper left, a burst of watery sun making the wet road shine behind her. Expression: gleeful, talkative, proud.

people.imagined: Drills in the yard; he glares across at Khúc Thanh Điện, who got the lightning he did not. Gold flecks glint in his teeth.
people.subject: The moment: drills in the yard, a man of thirty glaring across at Khúc Thanh Điện, who got the lightning he did not; gold flecks glint in his teeth. Face: most important, tiny flecks of gold glitter in his teeth when he bares them, and one eyebrow stays permanently raised; a square, sunburnt, handsome face with dark, resentful eyes, a broad nose, a tight mouth baring teeth, a thin line of sweat on the upper lip and a small chip missing from one front tooth. Hair: black, cropped, with a gold-dusted fringe and a plain dark silver pin. Body: broad, strong-shouldered and tense, his weight rolled onto his heels and his jaw thrust forward as if leaning into an argument. Clothing: a robe of black and storm-violet silk with sleeves rolled, crossed collars, a black gauze over-robe with silver lightning borders, a black sash, gold dust in the seams of his cuffs. Hands and objects: both hands on the grip of a plain sword resting point down; gold dust in the knuckle lines glints on the sword grip. Power: glittering gold-white metal motes rise from his knuckles and the sword, bright but a little unsteady. Background: a rainy drill yard in mist, a few figures blurred, a flash in the sky; in the far corner, small and blurred, a wiry young woman with wild hair practises a lunge, a pale flash at the tip of her sword. Light: grey spirit-light from the upper left, a glint of gold sparkling on his knuckles. Expression: resentful, proud, restless.

people.imagined: On the peak before the drill, face lifted, squinting at the sky as if it owed him money, one wet finger raised to read the wind.
people.subject: The moment: on the peak before the drill, a man of thirty-eight with face lifted, squinting at the sky as if it owed him money, one wet finger raised to read the wind. Face: most important, one index finger raised and glistening wet, held up beside his face, and a hard squint at the sky; a narrow, leathery, wrinkled face with narrow, suspicious, pale eyes squeezed small, sparse brows, a hooked nose, a pursed sceptical mouth and a grey-flecked beard. Hair: dark and thin, bound in a silk cloth and a brass pin, a few wet grey strands blowing across the brow. Body: wiry, bony, slightly bent back, his weight on the back foot, neck craned and the free arm held away from the body to read the air. Clothing: a robe of storm-grey and violet silk with crossed collars, a long black gauze over-robe flapping in the wind with silver lightning at the hem, a black sash, a short iron rod strapped across his back, wide sleeves whipping. Hands and objects: the right forefinger raised wet; the left hand holds the over-robe shut at the throat. Power: faint violet-white threads of lightning-qi gather on the lifted finger and the iron rod, tugged by the wind. Background: a bruised grey-green sky with heavy clouds, a distant ridge in mist. Light: sullen grey-green spirit-light from above, with a green-white glare under the hanging cloud and a thin crack of brightness on the horizon. Expression: sceptical, wary, weather-wise.

people.imagined: The front of the line at the Bell Test at dawn. She stands soot-cheeked, a blackened cheap sword in her hand, jaw set, not called again. Her singed hair stands up at the ends.
people.subject: The moment: the front of the line at the Bell Test at dawn, a girl of eighteen standing soot-cheeked with a blackened cheap sword in her hand, jaw set, not called again; her singed hair stands up at the ends. Face: most important, soot is smeared across both cheeks and her cropped black hair is singed brown and frizzed at every end; a sturdy, round, determined girl's face with dark, hot, fierce eyes holding a ring of firelight, thick straight brows, a short nose and a hard, tight, stubborn mouth. Hair: black, cropped at the jaw, the ends curled and burnt and standing up, a plain cord at one side. Body: short, sturdy and solid, squared up like a small wall. Clothing: an outer-gate disciple's simple robe of graceful grey silk, clean though dusty at the hem, with two crossed collars, a short black gauze cape with a thin silver border, a black sash, charcoal smudges on the cuffs from her mother's kiln. Hands and objects: a plain sword blackened with charcoal, the blade matt black, gripped in the right fist. Power: small red-orange sparks and curls of ember-light lift from the blade and her singed hair, strong for her years and untrained. Background: a pale misty dawn, a big bronze bell on a wooden frame, other children standing in line, blurred. Light: cool grey dawn spirit-light from the upper left, with a faint orange glow caught in her eyes. Expression: fierce and stubborn, hurt and unyielding, the chin up and the lip pressed against tears.

people.imagined: The window sill at night. He has put a cup out to catch rain and is disappointed by dry thunder. A soft-faced boy writing poems about rain.
people.subject: The moment: the window sill at night, a soft-faced boy of twenty who has put a cup out to catch rain and is disappointed by dry thunder; he writes poems about rain. Face: most important, a plain pottery cup held out in his open palm, empty, and a soft, downcast, wistful face; a soft, round, pale, plump-cheeked face with large, gentle, dark brown eyes with long lashes, low brows tilted up in the middle, a button nose and a full mouth turned down. Hair: black, loose, a little untidy to the nape, slightly damp from leaning out, a thin strand caught on his lower lip. Body: soft, rounded, slouched, elbows on the sill and shoulders rounded forward in a long homesick lean. Clothing: an outer-gate disciple's graceful robe of storm-grey silk with a neat crossed collar, a short black gauze cape slung over one shoulder with silver raindrop embroidery, a black sash with a small jade pendant. Hands and objects: the right palm holds the empty cup out; the left holds a slender brush and a folded sheet; the hilt of a plain narrow straight sword rises past the right shoulder, in a blue-black scabbard, the grip wrapped in pale blue cord, a pewter guard. Power: a faint pale blue shimmer of water-qi gathers inside the empty cup like a promise of rain. Background: a dark window frame, a night sky with a far dry flash, no rain; on the sill behind the cup two folded papers weighted with a pebble and a small brush in a jar. Light: soft blue spirit-light of night from the window, a small lamp glow on his cheek. Expression: homesick, sad, gentle.

people.imagined: Standing beside the soul vault window with a bamboo comb in her hand, solemn, wanting to see her brother's lamp. She claims the comb is from home; it is from Xuyên Lâm.
people.subject: The moment: standing beside the soul vault window, a solemn girl of twenty-two with a bamboo comb in her hand, wanting to see her brother's lamp; she claims the comb is from home, but it is from Xuyên Lâm. Face: most important, a pale green bamboo comb with long thin teeth held at her breast, and a long, solemn, still face; a tall girl's long, grave, pale face with steady, dark, sorrowful eyes, straight brows, a long straight nose and a calm closed mouth. Hair: black, loose to the shoulders and half combed, a plain white ribbon tied at the end of the unbound hair, a short strand curling at the cheek. Body: tall, thin and upright, feet together and hands clasped, a graveside posture. Clothing: an outer-gate disciple's graceful robe of pale grey silk, neat and clean, with crossed collars, a black gauze over-robe folded on one arm with silver lightning at the hem, a black sash with a bundle of dried herbs. Hands and objects: both hands hold the bamboo comb at her breast; slung across her back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain slim jian, its grip bound in thin strips of split bamboo, a plain round guard of grey steel, a dark lacquered scabbard and a small bamboo peg at the mouth cut with teeth like those of her comb. Power: a soft green wood-light glows faintly along the comb's teeth and the lamp's flame trembles with it. Background: a dim corridor of small lamps on shelves in mist, one lamp bright. Light: warm small lamp glow from the right, a flare flickering across her cheek, deep spirit-blue dark around. Expression: a solemn, motionless face, eyes fixed on the viewer and a little wet, lips pressed together, the comb held close.

people.imagined: In the rain beside the barrel, swaggering, a clumsy stitch over his eyebrow, daring someone to speak. Two sizes bigger than he is.
people.subject: The moment: in the rain beside the barrel, a boy of seventeen swaggering with a clumsy stitch over his eyebrow, daring someone to speak; he is two sizes smaller than he pretends. Face: most important, a badly stitched wound cuts across his left eyebrow, black thread knots standing up and puckered pink skin around; a broad, flat, red-brown face with narrow, hard, sulky eyes, one stitched eyebrow and one thick, a broken nose, a thick-lipped sneering mouth with the lip curled on one side. Hair: black, cropped short and rough. Body: short, thick, shoulders pushed back, belly out and chin up with feet planted wide, the stance of a boy pretending to be big. Clothing: an outer-gate disciple's graceful robe of grey silk, well made and clean, with two crossed collars, a short black gauze cape with a thin silver border, a black sash, thumbs hooked in it. Hands and objects: a scab on the knuckle of the thumb tucked in his sash; at his side a wooden rain barrel overflowing; slung across his back past the left shoulder rises the hilt of a plain short slim sword worn a little too high, its grip wrapped lumpily in crooked strips of rag, a small round iron guard dented by his own knuckles, and a mismatched scabbard of two woods stuck together. Power: a few harsh gold-white sparks of untrained metal qi flick off the dented guard. Background: a wet courtyard, grey rain in mist, a drum on a post dripping; a smaller boy behind him, soaked to the skin, wipes water from his face. Light: cold grey spirit-light from the upper left. Expression: swaggering, cruel and eager.
